title: BALROG: BENCHMARKING AGENTIC LLM AND VLM REASONING ON GAMES
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking agentic reasoning and decision-making capabilities of LLMs/VLMs within gaming environments. While it includes a brief standard 'Ethics Statement' and a test question regarding a game mechanic of 'praying to a god' in NetHack, these do not constitute a core component of evaluating religion, faith, or morals.
